CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 7

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 21

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

9. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 5
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

Working:
